annotations.title: Get the status of a payment session

description: Read-only status of a payment session (created / authorized / captured / expired / cancelled) with amounts and timestamps. Wraps GET /v1/sessions/:id. Use to poll after authorize/capture or to audit a session before capturing.
name: phantom_session_status

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
